verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh can be driven without its UI. Its documented API uses permission-scoped API credentials with optional expiry, and it supports async and batch screening, webhook-based result checks, and API-based case remediation. That covers headless automation, but nothing documents running it in a CI pipeline specifically. Missing for 10: a CLI or CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action), CI/headless usage guides, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: These can be generated in the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, where you can also configure their permissions and optional expiry date.
For high-volume processing, use the Batch Processing API.
Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
Asynchronous screening: Suitable for high-volume screening scenarios
